items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment

items.headline: YTD: SPX +16% vs S&P +12% — outperforming
items.detail: Year-to-date SPX6900 is +16% against the S&P 500's +12% — ahead by 4pp (flipped this week).

items.checkable: Both indexed to their first close of the year; S&P from bundled + banked closes.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 26,715 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,348 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-4.9% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 8.02M SPX. 4w -1.3% · 12w -4.9% · 26w -10.7%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-4.9% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: SOPR 0.942 — coins moving at a loss
items.detail: Spent-output profit ratio is 0.942: coins that moved on-chain realised a loss on average. Sustained <1 = capitulation, >1 = profit-taking.
items.framing: On-chain realised behaviour — loss-realisation (SOPR 0.942).
items.note: Only coins that MOVED; a behaviour read, not a signal.
